An infinite -evalue runs with the redo too (blast_traceback.c:1272-1275). nq.fna against rps_mini, outfmt 6.

# Rows db.evnan.rpt.o1[35].* (line RG, X-evalue-nan, 2026-11-28): the JSON reports with `-evalue` NaN or infinite. NCBI's JSON stream throws at the report's params.expect after its key (objostrjson.cpp:210-217: its 802.5 post, CSerialException eInvalidData); outfmt 15's report function catches it (blastxml2_format.cpp:879-890: the exception's post, the next report after its separator, the document's end, exit status 0), 13's does not (the side file ends at the key, the master file stays empty, exit status 255).
